primaryStandards.description: I can interpret conditional statements and identify converse, inverse, and contrapositive statements.
I can evaluate arguments and use counterexamples to disprove false statements.
I can construct valid geometric proofs, including proofs by contradiction.
I can prove and apply relationships involving lines, angles, and angle pairs.
I can describe transformations and write coordinate rules for images and preimages.
I can determine whether a transformation preserves distance.
I can draw transformed figures on a coordinate plane after a sequence of transformations.
I can use rigid transformations to justify that two figures are congruent.
